note: RAW JSON pane of the admin window: the core's own server configs by name on the left, the file itself in an editor on the right, the two Discord mirror switches under it and RELOAD/APPLY at the bottom. Created by OZ_VppMenu.OnCreate under OZ_VppRoot at [0, vpp.paneY]. Names RawList, RawEdit, MirrorLabel, MirrorRolesLabel, RawHint, BtnMirrorText, BtnMirrorRolesText and the four button names are read by OZ_VppMenu.c.

frame.name: PaneRaw
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open tab's pane and hides the rest.

listbox.name: RawList
listbox.note: Only configs whose owner is the core: a glue mod's own file belongs to whoever draws it.

field.name: RawEdit
